name: Tyme Hall
purpose: Public read-surface for present institutional state, inherited canon, active experimentation, relational navigation and governed contribution in the Sovereign Intelligence ecosystem.

epistemic_policy.rule: Presence in the Hall does not imply validation. Preserve provenance and uncertainty, and report contradictions rather than resolving them by assumption.

public_surface_primitive.office: present approved institutional state; read-only and non-authorizing
public_surface_primitive.scrolls: reviewed public inheritance that crossed an explicit publication boundary
public_surface_primitive.laboratory: active becoming; hypotheses, experiments and bounded work remain non-canonical unless separately promoted
public_surface_primitive.constellation: relational navigation derived from retained institutional relationships rather than a second authority source
public_surface_primitive.contribution: governed paths for challenge, correction, reproduction and participation without automatic authority

institutional_model.branch: bounded evolving path of a Work
institutional_model.trail: append-only lineage of meaningful Branch events
institutional_model.scroll: reviewed public inheritance with explicit identity, provenance, epistemic posture and stewardship

first_publication.title: AGI Manifesto Scroll - Autonomous Governing Intelligence

validation.rule: Do not coach an evaluator after a cold-start run begins. Misunderstandings are validation data.
